summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  ### What I found before proposing anything I had an agent trace the full watchlist path (client `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `api.ts` → route registration → `modules/watchlist` auth middleware → DB schema) rather than guess at a fix. Result: **the code as written looks correctly scoped.** No anonymous/guest fallback, no localStorage involvement, no hardcoded watchlist id, every handler filters by the real `user_id`, and logout unmounts the page so no stale client cache survives into the next login.  Two things stood out as worth verifyi
